description: Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_reserve UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/reserves, or its /:id/withdraw and /:id/link); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the holder wallet. A reserve moves no NET and holds none. Ask net_reserve_status where it stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
